title: Jagged Springy Egyptian Chicken Skewers
description: Charred and springy Egyptian dish featuring birds-eye chillies and soffritto-base, perfect for midnight cravings. This raw-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy your taste buds.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soffritto-base, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the soffritto mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
While the chicken is cooking, slice the birds-eye chillies into thin rings.
Once the chicken is done, brush the chilli rings onto the skewers.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional chilli rings if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
